course_title: Active Server Pages Network Enabled Technologies (ASP.NET)
description: This course covers the fundamentals of ASP.NET, including the architecture of web applications, server-side programming with C#, and the use of ASP.NET Web Forms and MVC framework. Topics include data binding, state management, session and application state, and the use of ADO.NET for database interaction. Students will explore advanced topics such as asynchronous programming, caching strategies, and security mechanisms including authentication and authorization. The course also includes the use of ASP.NET Core for cross-platform development, RESTful web services, and integration with cloud platforms like Azure. Specific technologies covered include LINQ, Entity Framework, and the use of HTML5 and CSS3 for front-end development. The course emphasizes the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications using industry-standard practices and methodologies.

clos.text: Define the architecture and components of ASP.NET, including Web Forms, MVC, and Core frameworks.
Describe the process of data binding and state management techniques in ASP.NET Web Forms.
Explain the use of ADO.NET and Entity Framework for database operations in ASP.NET applications.
Apply security best practices, including authentication and authorization, in ASP.NET applications.
Implement a full-stack web application using ASP.NET Core, integrating RESTful services and cloud platforms.

topics: Introduction to ASP.NET and its architecture
Overview of Web Forms and MVC frameworks
C# programming for server-side web development
Connecting to databases using SQL Server
Validation and error handling in ASP.NET
Creating views and models in MVC
RESTful web services in ASP.NET Core
Integration with cloud platforms like Azure
